basic_details.job_title: GGSGH Junior Resident Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 21 Posts
basic_details.short_information: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

qualification.education_qualification: MBBS Degree. Internship completed on or after 27.11.2024. Valid DMC certificate or applied acknowledgement slip for DMC at the time of interview.
qualification.details: Qualification: MBBS Degree; Internship completed on or after 27.11.2024; Valid DMC certificate or applied acknowledgement slip for DMC at the time of interview Experience: Candidates have not completed one year of Junior Residency in any recognized institution including regular & adhoc period Age limit: Below 30 years Age relaxation: PwD As per Govt. of India Rules | Other conditions: | Hostel accommodation is compulsory for JRs, subject to availability DMC Certificate should be submitted within 02 week of joining, failing which service may be terminated

how_to_apply: Fill in the application form available with this advertisement.

Attach self-attested copies of date of birth proof, DMC certificate or acknowledgement slip, internship proof, MBBS degree with mark sheets and attempt certificate, experience certificate if any, and an undertaking.
Submit at the Establishment Branch, 8th Floor, B Block, GGSG Hospital between 10.00 AM and 03.00 PM on or before 25.11.2026 up to 03.00 PM.
Check the list of eligible candidates on the hospital notice board on 26.11.2026 at 11.30 AM.
Report on 27.11.2026 between 9:30 AM and 10:30 AM at Establishment Branch, B Block, 8th floor with all original certificates.
important_instructions: No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the interview All original certificates must be brought for verification The number of posts are provisional and may vary Detail of vacancy and result of interview available at www.health.delhigovt.nic.in

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: MBBS Degree; Internship completed on or after 27.11.2024; Valid DMC certificate or applied acknowledgement slip for DMC at the time of interview Experience: Candidates have not completed one year of Junior Residency in any recognized institution including regular & adhoc period Age limit: Below 30 years Age relaxation: PwD As per Govt. of India Rules Other conditions: Hostel accommodation is compulsory for JRs, subject to availability DMC Certificate should be submitted within 02 week of joining, failing which service may be terminated

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for GGSGH Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates who completed internship earlier than 27.11.2024 Candidates who have completed one year of Junior Residency in any recognized institution including regular and adhoc period

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Purely adhoc basis for a period of 89 days or till the post is filled up on regular basis, whichever is earlier Appointment subject to medical fitness and verification of education, caste and DMC registration certificates

content_sections.text: Written test Walk-in interview Written test and walk-in interview on 27.11.2026 List of eligible candidates displayed on hospital notice board on 26.11.2026 at 11.30 AM; no separate intimation

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Date of birth proof Valid DMC certificate or applied acknowledgement slip for DMC Internship completion proof MBBS Degree with mark sheets and attempt certificate Experience certificate, if any Undertaking that information given is true and nothing is concealed Copy of Secondary School Certificate as date of birth proof DMC/DCI Registration Certificate Caste/PH/any other relaxation certificate ID proof
